neighbours.label: the contraction token 't / ’t after a form of 'be' (isn't, aren't, wasn't, weren't), as opposed to don't, can't, won't and didn't
fire: Honestly, it isn't worth the long drive.
My parents aren't coming to the party.
The bridge wasn’t safe after the storm.
This soup isn’t hot enough for me.
It wasn't easy to find the old house.
Our neighbours aren’t home this week.
The answers weren’t in the back of the book.
quiet: Honestly, I don't want the long drive.
My parents can't come to the party.
The bridge won’t reopen after the storm.
Those samples didn't arrive on time.
This soup doesn’t taste good to me.
We couldn't find the old house.
Our neighbours don’t live here this week.
The answers hadn’t been printed in the book.

notes: The top 32 examples are all 'isn' + 't'. ' wasn't' reached 0.42 and ' aren't' 0.64 in probes, against 0.94 for isn't, so the label may be broader than the pole's strongest case; 'not' in 'is not often' reached 0.35.
